thread:
carol_sales: Orchid POC blocked. Client sends embeddings -> rerank and gets a 400 dims error plus sporadic 413s on big payloads. Can we triage? :mag:
ryan_engineer: Paste the error and a sanitized request payload please.
carol_sales: From their logs:
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query_embedding": [0.01, 0.02, ...],
  "candidates": [[...], [...]],
  "model": "rerank-xlarge"
}

HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 512"}
```
priya_ml: 1536 vs 512 — their embed model is compact. Also 413s when they tried sending 6k candidates. Two issues: dims and payload size.
lucas_se: Common root causes: using an older internal embed (512), accidentally base64-encoding floats (inflates payload), or concatenating vectors. Ask them to print `len(embedding)` and confirm type.
carol_sales: They said the client lib sometimes returns base64 strings for vectors in some codepaths.
ryan_engineer: If base64 present, decode inconsistencies cause parse errors and bloat -> triggers 413. Recommend normalize to JSON float arrays. Also chunk candidates to <= 300 for rerank-xlarge and use gzip.
priya_ml: Short-term unblock options: 1) Enable server-side embedding for POC (send raw text -> we embed to 1536 and rerank). 2) Client migrate to our 1536 embed model. 3) Provide a temporary projection 512->1536 (quality warning).
lucas_se: For quick test, try this cURL to use server-side embed:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"raw_documents":["doc1","doc2"],"query":"how to...","rerank_model":"rerank-xlarge","embed_on_server":true,"max_candidates":300}'
```
carol_sales: They ran the cURL and the dims error went away; latency increased ~120ms per 200 candidates. Client ops asked about cost and POC credits.
priya_ml: We can enable a small POC embed credit; sales should propose. For perf, suggest prefilter with ANN (client-side embed -> top-K 250) then rerank, or use rerank-large instead of xlarge.
nina_sec: Security: if they send raw customer data we need NDA before ingesting PII. For Dedicated/private deploys we'll need SAML/KMS details and infosec questionnaire. I'll share SOC2 and the questionnaire.
lucas_se: I'll flip an org-level feature flag for embed_on_server and doc_cache for 72h for Orchid and set max_candidates=300. Also will share a small client patch to normalize base64->float arrays.
ops_bot: Feature toggles updated: embed_on_server=true, doc_cache=true, max_candidates=300 for org-orchid at 2028-01-05T14:12:00Z
carol_sales: Thanks everyone. Orchid will validate latency & accuracy and report back. I'll open a finance thread for POC credit and start the NDA flow. :thumbsup:
